categories.name: ipc
categories.evidence: Touches src/interfaces/wallet.h and src/wallet/interfaces.cpp solely to expose a new wallet method to the GUI, which the category explicitly excludes unless interface mechanics are the point.
categories.rationale: Not a member of IPC because it only adds an interface method to support wallet/GUI functionality.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Implements wallet transaction rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and exposes it via a new RPC in src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp.
categories.rationale: Adds a direct RPC and GUI option to rebroadcast unconfirmed wallet transactions that dropped from mempools. The change solves a clear user pain point, replacing the tedious workaround of manually extracting raw transaction hex and invoking sendrawtransaction, but is reasonably deferrable.
